limitations: Synthetic Woo descriptions and eight dense technical attributes added to a public 7734-product snapshot; live diagnostics list 7932 products.
No forced GC, real Woo order, real gateway charge or email. GoPay HTTP transport mocked.
No visual browser validation of the new deployed version before redeploy. Checkout covered by actual SSR HTML, DOM state tests and CSS guards.
Process RSS compared; cgroup covers the shared test container. A bounded test cannot prove absence of a long-term leak.
Full suite followed by 55 affected tests and the 300-OEM check after the final redundant-normalization optimization.
